nodes.label: .`removeItem deletes matching item and publishes event`()
.`removeItem with unknown id is a no-op`()
.`updateItem replaces matching item and publishes event`()
.`updateItem with unknown id is a no-op`()
.`setShareAll sets all items shared and publishes event`()
.`bringToFront moves item to end of list and publishes event`()
.`bringToFront on already-front item is a no-op`()
.`sendToBack moves item to beginning of list and publishes event`()
.`sendToBack on already-back item is a no-op`()
